day_local: Isniinta Todobaadka 27-aad ee Waqtiga Caadiga ah
greeting: Magaca Aabbaha, iyo Wiilka, iyo Ruuxa Quduuska ah. Nabadda iyo nimcada Rabbigeenna Ciise Masiix ha idinla jirto.
penitential: Rabbiyow, noo naxariiso. Masiixow, noo naxariiso. Rabbiyow, noo naxariiso.
psalm_response: Rabbigu wuxuu weligiis xusuusan doonaa axdigiisa.
homily:
Waxaa jira subaxyo marka aad kaceyso oo aad dareemeyso in hawadu ay tahay mid qabow oo qoto dheer, adigoo fiirinaya booska uu Benjamin Vo mar walba fadhiisan jiray, adigoo xusuusanaya tallaabadii ugu dambeysay ee wiilkaaga. Maanta, adigoo jooga meeshan, waxaan eegaynaa qolka uu Benjamin ku qaatay saacadihiisa aamusnaanta, halkaas oo ay ku yaalliin buugaagtiisa teknoolojiyadda, kombuyuutarradiisa, iyo sawirrada diyaaradaha uu sida aadka ah u jeclaa. Wuxuu ahaa wiil aan kaliya akhriyin buugaagta, laakiin dhisayey fikirkiisa ku saabsan nolosha. Halkaas ayaynu ka billaabaynaa maanta, annagoo aan degdegeyn, annagoo si dhab ah u eegaya noloshaas quruxda badan ee uu Ilaahay inoo dhiibay mudada kooban.

Waxaan dooraneynaa hal sawir oo maanta nala socda: waa 'waddada'. Akhriska koowaad, St. Paul wuxuu ka digayaa inaan loo leexan waddo kale oo aan ahayn Injiilka Masiix. Laakiin Injiilka maanta, wuxuu inoo sawirayaa waddo kale oo dhab ah: waddada u dhaxaysa Yeruusaalem iyo Yerixoo. Waa waddada uu ninkii dhibanaha ahaa ku dhacay gacanta tuugada. Ben wuxuu ahaa wiil yaqaanay waddooyin badan—safarkiisii adduunka, garoomada diyaaradaha, iyo xitaa waddada uu ku riyoonayay inuu ku dhiso 'con chim airlines'. Laakiin waddada ugu muhiimsan ee uu Ben ku socday waxay ahayd waddada naxariista. 

Alan iyo Thao, waxaan ogahay in saddexdan bilood ee la soo dhaafay ay ahaayeen kuwo culayskooda wata. Waxaa jira waqtiyo habeenkii ah oo ay codadka gurigu aamusaan, oo ay xusuustaadu kusoo dhacdo dhoola-caddayntii Ben markii uu ku oran jiray 'Good morning, Dad.' Waxaad is-weydiinaysaan su'aalo culus: 'Maxaan seegnay? Ma jirtay wax aynu si kale u samayn karin?' Waxaan rabaa inaan halkaan si tartiib ah u joojino oo aan idiin sheego runta: Ma jiro wax aad seegnay. Ma jiro qof eed leh. Cudurku ma aha ciqaab, mana aha guuldarro waalid. Sida Ciise uga jawaabay su'aashii ku saabsanayd ninkii indhoolaha ahaa: 'Ma aha ninkan iyo waalidkiis toona.' Ilaah ma eedeeyo, mana aha in aad adinkuna is-eedaysaan. Xanuunka halkan yaalla waa mid dhab ah, laakiin culayskaas ma ahan mid aad adinku keenteen. 

Oo halkaas ayay nuurku ka soo galayaa qolka mugdiga ah. Injiilka maanta, markii wadaadkii iyo reer Lewi ay dhaafayeen ninkii dhaawaca ahaa, waxay u dhaafayeen dhinaca kale. Laakiin Samaariyaankii wuu istaagay. Wuxuu arkay ninkii, wuxuuna dareemay naxariis. Ben wuxuu lahaa qalbi noocaas ah. Xusuusnow markii uu ahaa shan iyo toban jirka, ee uu u sheegay waalidkiis inuu rabay inuu siiyo dhammaan lacagta sanduuqiisa yar si uu u caawiyo adeerkiis William oo xanuunsanayd. Ma uusan jebin sanduuqa, mana loo baahnayn, laakiin rabitaankaas saafi ah ee ahaa inuu dhiibo wax kasta oo uu haysto waa dabeecadda wiilkan qalbiga wanaagsan. Ben wuxuu ahaa Samaariyaanka noloshaada, wiilka mar walba diyaar u ahaa inuu bixiyo jacaylkiisa, xitaa markii uu isagu u baahnaa daryeel.

Ryan, walaal qaali ah, waan ogahay in mararka qaarkood aad dareemeyso in kursigaaga agtiisa uu yahay mid cidlo ah. Laakiin xusuuso in Ben uu ku jiro xusuustaada, riyooyinkaaga, iyo jacaylka aad wadaagteen. Ha ka cabsin inaad horay u socoto. Ben wuxuu rabaa inaad noqoto wiilka geesiga ah ee uu mar walba jeclaa. Wuxuu rabaa inaad ku raaxaysato nolosha, waayo adiga iyo isaga waxaa idin mideeyay jacayl aan dhimanayn. Marka aad dareento cidlo, xusuuso in Ben uu weli kula socdo waddada nolosha.

Markaad maanta ka baxaysaan meeshan, qaada hal shay oo yar oo aad gacanta ku haysaan: Ha is-edeynin, hana ka cabsanin inaad u dhiibto xanuunkaaga Ilaah. Ben wuxuu hadda ku sugan yahay nabadda gacmaha Aabbaha, wuxuuna idin leeyahay inaan la idin iloobin. Ilaah wuu idin jecel yahay, Ben-na wuxuu idin jecel yahay. Aamiin.
spiritual_communion: Ciise, waxaan aaminsanahay inaad joogto Sakramenti Quduuska ah. Waan ku jeclahay wax kasta, waxaana rabaa inaan ku qaato naftayda. Maadaama aanan hadda ku qaadan karin Sakramentiga, fadlan iigu kaalay ruux ahaan qalbigayga. Waxaan isku duubayaa sidii adigoo horey u joogay, waxaana gebi ahaanba isu dhiibayaa adiga. Weligaa ha ii oggolaan inaan kaa go'o. Aamiin.
closing: Rabbigu ha idin barakeeyo, ha idin xafido, oo ha idin siiyo nabaddiisa weligeed ah. Aamiin.
standing_petitions: Waxaan u baryeynaa Ben iyo dhammaan inta dhimatay, inay ku nastaan iftiinka iyo nabadda Masiixa.
Waxaan u baryeynaa dhammaan inta murugeysan, in Ilaahay qalbi qaboojiyo oo uu siiyo rajo iyo xoog.

readings.label: Akhriska Koowaad
readings.text: Walaalayaal, waan la yaabanahay inaad si dhakhso ah uga leexateen kan idiinku yeeray nimcada Masiixa, oo aad u raacdeen injiil kale (inkasta oo uusan jirin injiil kale). Laakiin waxaa jira dad idin qasaya oo raba inay qalloociyaan injiilka Masiixa. Laakiin xitaa haddii aanu annaga ama malaa'ig samada ka timid aanu idiinku wacdinno injiil ka duwan kii aanu idiinku wacdinay, ha iska habaaro! Sida aan horay u nidhi, oo aan haddana leeyahay, haddii qofna idiinku wacdinno injiil ka duwan kii aad hesheen, ha iska habaaro! Ma waxaan hadda raadinayaa inaan dadka raalli geliyo mise Ilaah? Mise waxaan raadinayaa inaan dadka raalli geliyo? Haddii aan weli dadka raalli gelin lahaa, ma aanan noqdeen addoonka Masiixa. Walaalayaal, waxaan rabaa inaad ogaataan in injiilka aan wacdiyey uusan ahayn mid bini'aadam ka yimid. Waayo kama aanan helin bini'aadam, mana la i barin, laakiin wuxuu ii yimid iyada oo loo marayo muujinta Ciise Masiix.

readings.label: Sabuurka
readings.text: Waxaan Rabbiga ugu mahadcelin doonaa qalbigayga oo dhan, kulanka iyo shirka kuwa xaqa ah. Wayn yihiin shuqullada Rabbiga, oo ku qurux badan dhammaan waxyaalahooda. Rabbigu wuxuu weligiis xusuusan doonaa axdigiisa. Shuqullada gacmihiisu waa aamin iyo caddaalad; amaradiisu waa sugan yihiin, weligood iyo weligoodba, lagu sameeyay run iyo sinnaan. Wuxuu dadkiisa u soo diray samatabbixin; wuxuu axdigiisa u adkeeyay weligiis; magiciisu waa quduus oo cabsi leh. Ammaantiisu weligeed bay sii jiri doontaa.

readings.label: Injiilka
readings.text: Waxaa kacay sharci-yaqaan raba inuu Ciise tijaabiyo, wuxuuna ku yiri, 'Macallimow, maxaan sameeyaa si aan u dhaxlo nolosha weligeed ah?' Ciise wuxuu ku yiri, 'Maxaa sharciga ku qoran? Sidee baad u akhridaa?' Wuxuu ugu jawaabay, 'Rabbiga Ilaahaaga u jeclow qalbigaaga oo dhan, naftaada oo dhan, xooggaaga oo dhan, iyo maskaxdaada oo dhan, deriskaagana u jeclow sida naftaada.' Wuxuu ku yiri, 'Si sax ah ayaad u jawaabtay; tan samee oo waad noolaan doontaa.' Laakiin isagoo raba inuu naftiisa xaq u yeelo, wuxuu Ciise ku yiri, 'Yaa deriskayga ah?' Ciise wuxuu ku jawaabay, 'Nin ayaa tuugo u dhacay markuu ka soo degayay Yeruusaalem oo ku socday Yerixoo. Way qaawiyeen, way garaaceen, waxayna uga tageen isagoo nus-dhiman. Wadaad ayaa waddadaas maray, laakiin markuu arkay ayuu dhinaca kale ka maray. Sidoo kale reer Lewi ayaa yimid meeshii, markuu arkay ayuu dhinaca kale ka maray. Laakiin nin Samaariyaan ah oo safar ahaa ayaa u yimid, naxariisna wuu u qaaday markuu arkay. Wuu u soo dhawaaday, wuxuuna boogihiisii ku shubay saliid iyo khamri, wuuna xiray. Markaasuu kor u qaaday xayawaankiisii, wuxuuna geeyay hoy, wuuna daryeelay. Maalintii xigtay wuxuu la soo baxay laba lacagta lacagta ah, wuxuuna siiyay ninkii hoyga hayay, wuxuuna ku yiri, "Daryeel, haddii aad wax kale ku bixisid, waan kuu soo celin doonaa markaan soo noqdo." Kumaa saddexdan, ra'yigaaga, ahaa deriska ninkii tuugadu dhacday?' Wuxuu ku jawaabay, 'Kii naxariista u sameeyay.' Ciise wuxuu ku yiri, 'Tag oo sidaas oo kale samee.'

day: Monday of the Twenty-seventh Week in Ordinary Time

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben,

Rafael Rizzo and his little brother Ben really need your help right now. Please bless them with good health and give them the strength to get through this together. Please watch over Brandon and Flor's health, too.

I miss you a whole bunch. I know you're up in heaven watching over all of us. Whenever you're able to, stop by to visit, yeah? I love you and miss you so much!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text:
Hey Ben - Miss you a whole bunch. Crying all day yesterday, i hope today will be better. Please guide our family through this grief... There's a 14 year old boy that just left earth on August 12... His name is Phero Aden Vo - look for him, maybe you guys can be friends...

Please pray for me and mom to have good health and strength.

I love and miss you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben, Trustin visited you today and left you a few airplane cards—we're putting them in your room for you. Please pray for Trustin and his family to stay healthy and strong. Be a guardian angel to Trustin and Ryan as they go through school, and help guide their steps through every year to come.
